textRuns.value: The web channel is about a quarter of the store channel by units and purchased amount, loses a third as much per unit (5.1 against 16.4), and carries costs the store channel does not record: shipping and a separate discount line. The Web Sales measure is left off this page on purpose: its column multiplies the extended sales price by quantity a second time, so it runs about a thousand times the comparable store figure; Web Net Paid is the revenue measure here. Ship mode types split web sales almost evenly, because the generator assigns modes at random; the point of the chart is that the Ship Mode and Warehouse dimensions resolve only through web_sales. Switch the trend chart to the Ship Date hierarchy in the field list to see the same sales shifted by the shipping lag.

Model capabilities: a role-played date (Sold and Ship) from one dimension, dimensions reachable from one fact only, per-unit calcs (Average Web Unit Net Profit), and a table that lines up the base measures the calculations are built from.
